subject.title: [Bug]: Sandbox prune does not clean up workspace directory

question: Should this focused prune workspace cleanup land as a narrow bug fix now, or be folded into the broader managed sandbox lifecycle work?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix deletes sandbox state and overlaps with an open fork fix plus a broader maintainer draft, so automation should not pick the permanent route by itself.

options.title: Land focused cleanup
options.body: Adopt or replace the focused fix so prune and recreate delete only eligible non-shared local sandbox workspaces after runtime removal, with regression tests.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle PR
options.body: Keep this issue open as supporting context and let the managed lifecycle PR define the full cleanup contract before merging any narrower fix.

options.title: Resolve linked branches first
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting open fork/draft paths before dispatching a new repair job so there is one canonical implementation route.

recommendation.title: Land focused cleanup
recommendation.body: Adopt or replace the focused fix so prune and recreate delete only eligible non-shared local sandbox workspaces after runtime removal, with regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest sandbox lifecycle history and authored the broader related lifecycle issue and draft PR.
